text_block_list.text:
"It was one day while preparing with Sweep 
Tosho for the Tiara route—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut up! If I say I'm going, I'm 
going! Come on, get ready! Hur-ry u-u-up!

Dragged along by Sweep Tosho, where we 
ended up was an art museum.
choice_data_list:
The "Lovely Strides Adorning the Tiara" 
exhibition?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, did you know? Looking at photos is 
a form of study too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma said so! Only girls who truly 
understand racing can use racing magic!
choice_data_list:
(Doing her own research just for 
that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...? What is it, covering your mouth like 
that?
choice_data_list: No, I was just thinking how glad I am...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! Aha, were you really that happy that I 
invited you out? You're pretty childish, 
you know~

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Don't think of it as a game, okay? This 
is part of your studies!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you understand... Come along now, 
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Staff
text_block_list.text:
A party of two, correct? Please present 
your tickets.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Familiar!
choice_data_list:
One adult ticket and one student ticket, 
please!

text_block_list.text:
Entering the venue, I looked at the photos 
of the Tiara route Umamusume alongside 
Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see... "Oka Sho", "Oka Sho"...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Found it!! The year Great-Grandma ran 
was...

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Air Groove's Oaks race! I just love 
the way she runs~.

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's race is in this one, too! 
Man, she was so strong back then.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Hishi Ama and the others are pretty 
famous too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Is this the photo of the two of them? 
Hmm, it really does have quite an impact.

Air Groove and Hishi Amazon. Numerous 
photos capturing the Umamusume who ignited 
the crowd's passion together.

As graceful as blooming flowers, yet 
filled with an overwhelming aura, just 
watching her took one's breath away, but—

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in the end, even Hishi Amazon 
couldn't reach him. In the Arima Kinen, 
against Narita Brian, that is."

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you can't really blame them, can 
you? After all, her opponent is a Classic 
Triple Crown Umamusume, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, auntie! What do you mean by that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "it can't be helped"? 
Hishiama was strong too, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yeah, I guess? But you know, 
that's just how it is... That's how it's 
always been, right?

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Girls who take the Triple Tiara route 
inevitably fall short in raw stamina and 
baseline strength compared to those on the 
Triple Crown route, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. Umamusume who choose 
the Classic Triple Crown route have this 
intense aura, like they've crossed the 
line between life and death.

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
I was rooting for Fine Motion in the Arima 
Kinen too, but that Symboli Kris S was 
just way too strong. It makes sense she 
couldn't win.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally"? ...Is that because Fine is on 
the Triple Tiara path and Kris S is on the 
Classic Triple Crown path?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So it's... "natural"?

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ Quite so~...

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but Air Groove-san had more than 
enough ability to compete, didn't she? She 
even won the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!"

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
"In the Arima Kinen after that, though, 
you gave up 1st place to a girl who didn't 
win a single crown in the Classic Triple 
Crown, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
That one win in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was 
definitely special. But that single 
victory was the only one I could claim in 
the Senior Year... In the end, that's 
'just how it goes.'

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
History itself has proven this fact. The 
title of "The Strongest" rightfully 
belongs only to the Umamusume who conquer 
the Classic Triple Crown trail!

—To begin with, the Classic Triple Crown 
and the Triple Tiara routes require 
entirely different aptitudes and 
capabilities.

Therefore, one cannot sweepingly declare 
that "one is superior to the other," 
but...

The Classic Triple Crown is the first 
"Triple Crown" ever established in 
Japanese racing, boasting a long history. 
On top of that, the running distances vary 
widely, demanding high adaptability.

"Just as the spectators were saying, 
'Umamusume on the Triple Crown route have 
more raw strength than those on the Tiara 
route'—"

It is also... a fact that such arguments 
and the race results demonstrating them 
have stacked up over time.

And in the middle of all this, as for 
Sweep Tosho—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is with that booooring story?!

"And just like that, she suddenly dashed 
out of the exhibition, and the moment she 
got back to the trainer's room, she began 
poring over the documents with furious 
intensity!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweep-san! Um, the documents regarding 
the Triple Tiara route you asked for, I 
left them over there...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rob Roy! ...Familiar, don't just 
stand there daydreaming! The documents! Go 
grab them, quickly!!
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it... but what's up?
O-Okay, got it... but what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Because! That was totally boring, wasn't 
it?! Didn't you think so too?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah... look, this one too!! Look at this 
article, right here!!

The old article she handed me read: 
'Historic Feat at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) — 
An Umamusume from the Triple Tiara Route 
Achieves Glory for the First Time in 17 
Years.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that ridiculous!? What 
'magnificent feat'!? What 'historical 
achievement'!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...? You mean that Air Groove-san has 
achieved something historically rare and 
truly magnificent—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's weird to praise me that 
much! Calling it a breakthrough, or a 
historic feat, that's just—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that basically saying, "You should 
have lost under normal circumstances"?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaagh, geeeez!! What is this!? Boring, 
boring, sooo booooriiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So what if you're from the Classic Triple 
Crown route?! So what if you're from the 
Triple Tiara route?! None of that matters 
on the track!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because strong Umamusume are just strong!! 
It's as simple as that, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet, everyone just assumes the Classic 
Triple Crown Umamusume are naturally 
stronger! Like "that's just how it is"!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Always whining and complaining about such 
boring, pointless crap...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Who cares about history or facts?! That's 
sooooo booooorrriiiing!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ............I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar. I'm going to use race magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I'm going to change everything!! 
I'll smash it all to pieces and wake 
everyone up!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Triple Crown, Tiara, who cares about 
that?! I'm gonna make everyone understand 
that the truly strong Umamusume is the one 
who's strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With my magic—my very own racing magic—I 
know I can!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because magic, magic is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—I can turn all the boring stuff upside 
down. I can change everything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You definitely, absolutely have that kind 
of power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it, familiar?! I won't take 'no' for 
an answer!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna search for magic for real! I'll 
search, find it, and definitely learn how 
to use it!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With the magic of racing, I'm gonna change 
the world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're going to help with that!! Got it?!

A grand, boundless ambition held by a tiny 
magical girl. To a question that sounded 
almost like a fairy tale, even still—
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's absolutely see this through!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of cooooourse I am!!

I nod vigorously. Because the magic has 
already begun the very moment she wished 
to do it herself.

And so, Sweep Tosho set out on a long, 
arduous journey in search of magic that 
could change the world—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ......Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san... That's amazing—
